profile_text.body:
Coursera is a for-profit public company, traded under the ticker COUR, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001651562. The company's site describes it as offering online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with instruction from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford, presented as a way to build job-ready skills and earn verifiable credentials.

The site describes Coursera Plus as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. It names programs such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. According to the site, learners commonly move into roles in project management, UX design, and data science, and it lists artificial intelligence, SQL, and web development among the broad subject areas available to browse.

The litigation record for the company shows 281 cases in California, and no individual cases are listed. No MCP servers are recorded for it.
